selection_rule: Items chosen from Earth Search sentinel-2-c1-l2a STAC metadata only (tile eo:cloud_cover, processing baseline, platform, day-of-year), before any pixels were viewed: lowest tile cloud cover in the target window, preferring the same platform and nearest day-of-year across T1/T2. AOI-level cloud is only known after acquisition (SCL) and is reported, not used to re-select.
expectation_rule: expected_outcome is declared before running the change provider. It is a hypothesis from dated public event records, not a pixel label.
reference_boxes_rule: reference_boxes_norm (normalized xyxy, union of boxes) were drawn by the analyst on T1/T2 true-colour previews (eval/change_real_pairs.py --rgb-only) BEFORE any change output was computed. They are coarse visual annotations of the documented event footprint, not pixel labels. No box is drawn where the event could not be localized visually.

pairs.event: Noida International Airport (Jewar, Uttar Pradesh): foundation stone laid 25 Nov 2021; runway and terminal built 2022-2024. T1 predates construction; T2 follows it.
pairs.reference_note: Airport parcel. T1 preview already shows the parcel as fallow bare land (acquired, cultivation stopped), so most within-box change is bare soil -> paved/built surface rather than vegetation -> built.
pairs.confounders: Rabi crops on surrounding farmland in both years; same platform and day-of-year limits phenology/illumination differences.

invalidated.reason: Acquisition defect: the AOI extends ~2.4 km past the east edge of tile 44PLV (native window cols 10570-11224 of 10980). rasterio silently clipped the read to 410 columns and the writer stretched them across the declared 654-column window, so both rasters are geometrically wrong while their metadata claims the full AOI. Detected by a same-datatake cross-tile comparison (44PLV vs 44PMV correlated 0.11). Acquisition now fails closed on windows outside the tile and on clipped reads. Replaced by water-puzhal-lake-2018-2019-pmv; the committed provenance is kept unchanged as evidence.

pairs.event: Chennai 2019 water crisis: Puzhal (Red Hills) reservoir near-empty by June 2019 ('Day Zero' declared 19 Jun 2019). NASA Earth Observatory published Landsat 8 images of the same lake for 31 May 2018 (near full) and 19 Jun 2019 (near empty).
pairs.reference_note: Open water visible in the T1 (5 Jun 2018) preview occupies the lower-right lobe of the AOI; T2 shows dry lakebed there.
pairs.confounders: T1 tile cloud cover 17%; tile 44PLV has ~17% swath-edge nodata. Exposed lake bed can be wet or vegetated.

pairs.event: Replacement for the invalidated 44PLV pair, same AOI and dates, on tile 44PMV which fully contains the AOI. Chennai 2019 water crisis: Puzhal reservoir near-empty by June 2019 ('Day Zero' declared 19 Jun 2019); NASA Earth Observatory published Landsat 8 images for 31 May 2018 (near full) and 19 Jun 2019 (near empty).
pairs.selection_note: Declared rule applied within the original 15 May - 30 Jun 2018 window restricted to tiles containing the AOI: 44PMV 2018-06-05 has the lowest tile cloud cover (38.65%). T1 is the same datatake as the invalidated pair's T1.
pairs.reference_note: Open water in the T1 (5 Jun 2018) preview: right side of the AOI plus the lower-left lobe; T2 (15 Jun 2019) shows exposed lakebed with residual shallow water on the far right. Drawn on the --rgb-only preview before the change provider was run.
pairs.confounders: T1 tile cloud cover 38.65% (AOI-level cloud from SCL); different platforms (S2A/S2B); 10-day day-of-year difference.

pairs.event: One Sentinel-2B datatake (15 Jun 2019, relative orbit 119) delivered as two overlapping L2A tile products. The AOI lies inside the 44PLV/44PMV overlap (UTM44 x 399960-409800), so both products cover it natively on the same 10 m lattice. The tiles' per-granule sensing times differ by ~3 s, so 44PMV is T1. Any detection is processing-induced (per-tile L2A atmospheric correction / scene classification), not surface change.
pairs.confounders: None expected; this is a processing-floor control.

pairs.event: Same reservoir: near-empty June 2019 (crisis) versus refilled after the 2020 north-east monsoon (late May 2021).
pairs.reference_note: Open water visible in the T2 (30 May 2021) preview: an L-shaped extent along the right and bottom of the AOI; T1 shows dry lakebed there.
pairs.confounders: Different platforms (S2B/S2A); 16-day day-of-year difference; T1 tile cloud cover 8%.

pairs.event: Kancha Gachibowli (Hyderabad): large-scale clearing of scrub/tree cover on ~400 acres reported from 30 Mar 2025, halted by the Supreme Court on 3 Apr 2025. T1 is 2 days before, T2 4 days after the halt.
pairs.reference_note: Not localized. In full and zoomed previews the cleared parcel could not be identified with confidence; T2 is greener/darker than T1 across the whole scene. No survey boundary was retrieved, so no box was drawn (drawing one where change appears would be circular).
pairs.confounders: Dry-season scrub has modest NDVI, so vegetation loss may be spectrally small. Location of the cleared parcel inside the AOI is taken from visual inspection, not a survey boundary.

pairs.event: Wayanad (Kerala) debris flow of 30 Jul 2024 through Punchirimattam, Mundakkai and Chooralmala. Dry-season images one year apart bracket the event. ISRO/NRSC reported an ~8 km debris flow from crown to run-out along the Iruvaniphuza river.
pairs.reference_note: Bright debris-flow scar visible in T2 running diagonally from about (0.88, 0.20) to (0.43, 0.78); three boxes follow the strip and necessarily include surrounding forest.
pairs.confounders: Tile 43PFN has ~27% swath-edge nodata; hill-shadow and orographic cloud are common; one year of vegetation regrowth on the scar.

pairs.event: Established planned city sectors (Chandigarh sectors 17-22 area); 7-day interval, both tile-clear. Any detection estimates the sensor/illumination/registration/atmosphere noise floor (plus any genuine week-scale change).
pairs.confounders: Different platforms (S2B vs S2A) so inter-sensor calibration differences are included in the floor.

pairs.event: Same established sectors one year apart, same platform, 15-day day-of-year difference.
pairs.confounders: Urban greenery phenology, small construction, year-to-year atmosphere.

pairs.event: Same sectors, 5 days apart; T2 tile cloud cover 52%. Measures detections caused by cloud/shadow when dataMask carries no cloud mask.
pairs.confounders: AOI-level cloud fraction unknown until SCL is read; if the AOI is clear this control is inconclusive.

pairs.event: Irrigated Punjab farmland: rabi wheat in growth (mid-Feb) versus post-harvest (early May). Surface change is real but is crop phenology, not land-cover conversion.
pairs.confounders: Stubble burning and early kharif sowing may occur by early May.

pairs.event: Same AOI and dates as the vegetation case, but T1 is taken from the UTM-43 tile and T2 from the UTM-44 tile, as a naive per-date search would do on the 78E zone boundary. Expected: reprojection_required.
pairs.confounders: None; this is a validation-gate test on real products.

pairs.event: Jewar pair with T2's window deliberately offset by 2 columns (20 m), simulating per-date AOI snapping. Same CRS and size; expected: grid_alignment_incompatible.
pairs.confounders: Deliberately constructed misalignment of real data.
